Les Yeux ouverts

L'intelligence artificielle expliquée à ceux qui ne codent pas

Artificial intelligence explained to French-speaking Africans who do not code. Part one opens the machine: tokens and the extra cost they put on African languages, the map of meaning, attention, training, why it invents. Part two follows AI agents that act on their own, in business, work and daily life. Part three makes the case: those who say not now are heard and answered, history is recalled, and a programme is laid out so the continent does not look away.

William Foteping · 29 sections · 100,096 words · about 455 minutes
